payload.text:
I reviewed `search-filters` against `main` (2 commits) and didn't change anything. All 5 tests pass, but there's a blocker, so **please don't merge yet.**

### 🔴 Blocker: SQL injection in `src/query.js`
```js
clauses.push("name ILIKE '%" + term + "%'");
```
This pastes the search term straight into the SQL string. A term like `x' OR '1'='1` breaks out of the quotes, and the README itself says request values must never go into the SQL string. The fix is to use a placeholder and put the value in `params`:
```js
params.push('%' + term + '%');
clauses.push(`name ILIKE $${params.length}`);
```
Number the placeholder from `params.length` rather than hard-coding `$1`, because category may already have taken `$1`. You may also want to escape `%`, `_` and `\` in the term so users can't send their own wildcards.

### 🟡 Should fix
- **Tests don't catch the injection.** They only check that the SQL contains `name ILIKE`. Assert the exact output instead, e.g. `{ where: 'WHERE name ILIKE $1', params: ['%red%'] }`, and add a test with a term containing a quote.
- **The in-stock test was deleted.** The old "in-stock is a literal condition" test got replaced rather than renamed, so `inStock` on its own has no test now.
- **Renaming `buildFilters` to `buildWhere` breaks the API.** Nothing in this repo still calls `buildFilters`, but anything outside it that does will break. Either keep an alias or note the rename in the CHANGELOG.
- **Sorting by `rank DESC` may not work.** The default sort, `relevance`, orders by a `rank` column. Nothing on this branch computes a rank, and ILIKE doesn't produce one. Unless the table really has a `rank` column, that query will error.

### 🟢 Nits
- `src/paginate.js`: `MAX_PAGE` is really the largest page size, so `MAX_PAGE_SIZE` would be clearer. Also, `| 0` quietly turns non-numbers and huge values into odd results. That's fine for clamping, but worth knowing.
- Nothing tests `orderBy`, including the fallback for an unknown sort, or the lower end of paging (`page 0`, negative numbers).
- The 0.6.0 CHANGELOG entry doesn't mention pagination.

Once the injection fix and an exact-output test are in, I'm happy to take another look.
